description: Bristol Bus Stops is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bristol City Council. This data-set provides the "Naptan Codes", Bus Stop Name, Stop Location, a yes/no field if the stop has a Seat, a text field that indicates if the stop has a Shelter, Pole or Lamp Post and a yes/ no field that indicates whether the Bus Stop has a raised kerb. Coverage: Bristol City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Bristol City Council. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
